Background migrations still fire (backend.err.log shows 'Batch2 startup migration: {"migrated": 1}' from an earlier cold boot; PERSONA-1 backfill runs after boot). test_iteration_112.py: 4/4 PASSED x3 consecutive runs (12/12). All 11 downstream migrations (purge, participants v2, LOOP-1 cron, LCA-1 indexes, email verification backfill, email-change/share-link/onboarding-draft/PPC milestone indexes, persona backfill) are inside the same background task and each wrapped in try/except — a failure in one won't skip subsequent ones.

Orthogonal (as noted by main agent, do NOT flag): GET /api/statements + GET /api/budget/current still 500 for cathy on dashboard load; documented in iteration_101.

If server.py startup hooks are touched again, restart backend and hit /api/health within 2s to confirm no regression. SD-3 UI flow selectors (sd3-pair-review-page, sd3-candidates-list, sd3-{confirm|dismiss|uncertain|draft-letter}-{cid}) are all stable and reusable.
rca of the issue: K8s readiness timeout was caused by 11 sequential heavy startup migrations (batch2, batch3, purge, v2 migrations, LOOP1 cron, index creations, persona backfill) executing before uvicorn could bind. Fix: wrap all in asyncio.create_task inside on_event('startup') so control returns immediately; batch3 additionally sleeps 30s to let readiness probes complete first. Verified: cold-start /api/health = 217ms first hit.
